main_text.head: ZACHARIAE VRSINI, Silesij, viri in omni disciplinarum genere exercitatissimi. Theologi summi, vitae inculpatae, iudicio admirabili, labore indefesso, charis in Christo fratris, Memoriae.

p.i: Vrsinum dederas unum, Deus optime, nobis / Sufficeret nobis tua qui pene omnia solus: / Siue homines ille humana ratione doceret, / Artibus excultus cunctis: siue entheus illum / Spiritus arcanos depromere pectore sensus / Iusserat: & sacri quatientem lampada verbi, / Discutere errorum nebulas, cuneosque ruentum / Diuinis fretum telis, hinc inde luporum / Rumpere, tutantem Christi diuinitus agnos. / Ergo quid, Vrsino properata morte perempto, / Crediderim superesse gregi, qui sicut in vno / Cuncta habuit quondam sic cuncta amisit in un[?] / Sic ego, multa gemens, & planctibus aera compl[?] / Quum Deus excelsa miseratus ab arce gemet[?] / Ponemodum lacrymis, inquit, Vobisque sibique / Viuit, qui vitam impendit vobisque, mihique. / Ergo, Vrsine, abfit, nobisque, tibique, Deoque / Vt te sequentem, deinceps ceu lumine caecum / Ploremus stulti: quem tot tantique labores / Aeternum aeterna consecrauere saluti.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of lines 1 to 14, so some line endings are partly lost and marked [?]. The lower right mark is not legible and is not transcribed. The page number is not visible. Ligature forms such as the stylised u/n in "unum" and "vno" are read as u/v and n per the spelling rule.
